craft_notes: Sthāyin: eye-road (the road the sight walks is HIS, only-that — v116's wherever now traces the EYE). Sanskrit: yatra yatra ca dṛṣṭir gacchati...pūrṇātman → L4 keeps wherever-eye then only-that-natured. Rows: row 3 (his→full-selfness). Close: full-selfness (pūrṇātman — the full-word lands after where-go question: fullness answers, not location). Rejected: 'gaze wandering' casual — killed: eye-road kept (dṛṣṭi-gati as the tracked path); 'he pervades objects' — killed: HIS-only-that-natured kept (the gnarly Sanskrit's own grammar: tasya tannimittamātraṃ).

l4.sanskrit_cite: yatra yatrākṣamārgeṇa caitanyaṃ vyajyate vibhoḥ | tasya tanmātradharmitvāc cillayād bharitātmatā

reads_against.argmap: What is manifested on the eye-road? → On every eye-road, consciousness only; dissolving in cit, full-self-ness.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness reached through force of attention)
